description: This file defines the AggregatedQueueFlowController class in the Orleans.Streams namespace, which implements IQueueFlowController by aggregating multiple other controllers. It provides a constructor to set a default max add count and implements the GetMaxAddCount method to compute the minimum max add count among its contained controllers.

classes.name: AggregatedQueueFlowController
classes.description: A class that aggregates multiple IQueueFlowController instances, implementing IQueueFlowController. It inherits from List<IQueueFlowController> and provides logic to determine the maximum add count based on contained controllers.

methods.name: AggregatedQueueFlowController
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the controller with a default maximum add count.

methods.name: GetMaxAddCount
methods.description: Returns the minimum max add count among all contained controllers, or the default if none are present.
